name: get_paper_text_by_id
description: Retrieve the full text of a research paper using its unique identifier (ID). Use this tool when you have a specific paper ID mentioned in the request and need to access its content. Do NOT use this tool for searching papers or retrieving metadata; for those tasks, consider using 'search_pubmed' or similar tools.

parameters.name: paper_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the paper, which may be a DOI, PubMed ID, or other recognized format. Must be a valid ID; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_references
parameters.description: Whether to include the references cited in the paper's text. Set to false to reduce response size if references are not needed. Defaults to true.

paper_id.description: The ID of the paper (echoes input).

full_text.description: The complete text of the paper, including all sections (abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, etc.).

references.description: List of references cited in the paper, only present if include_references is true. Each reference includes title, authors, and publication details.

return_schema.description: Object containing the paper ID, full text, and optional references.
